New-client onboarding is often a manual scramble.

A contract gets signed. Then someone creates a folder, copies client details into the CRM, drafts a welcome email, and looks up calendar availability.

That is four steps for work that happens every time you win a deal.

The myth is that fixing this requires months of custom software development. The reality is that standard tools like Zapier, n8n, or Make can link your existing CRM, email, and storage in a single afternoon.

When a deal closes, trigger a webhook. Let the system create the workspace, send the welcome packet, and book the call.

Save human attention for the actual client relationship.
